verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's HyperAgent documents `page.ai()` for executing natural-language actions and `page.extract()` for structured data, but nothing in the pack describes an observe or plan primitive that previews candidate actions before committing. Live watching and session recordings show actions only during or after execution, so they are not a pre-commit preview. The axis applies to an AI browser-automation product, so the absence of evidence yields none.
